purpose: Teach: 親しま/似通っ/嗚呼/取り敢えず/ながめ/きびしい/ようするに/よーく

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、クラスでみんなに親しまれてんな
lines.en: You know, Riku, you're actually pretty popular in class.
lines.style: Teasing observation. Warm but with a sarcastic edge. Not quite a compliment, more like noticing something obvious he's being coy about. Light, quick delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前と俺、好み似通ってるよな、桜
lines.en: Our tastes are pretty similar, aren't they, Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet deflection. Soft, almost deflecting the compliment by turning it back on her. Thoughtful tempo. Eyes somewhere else — genuinely considering something.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、嗚呼、テスト返却怖いな
lines.en: Yeah, yeah... getting the test papers back is going to be rough.
lines.style: Dry, slightly resigned sarcasm. A small sigh woven in. The tone of someone who already knows how it'll go but is joking about it anyway to keep it light.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、取り敢えず宿題やれよ、桜
lines.en: Look, just actually do your homework first, okay Sakura?
lines.style: Practical advice wrapped in quiet exasperation. Not harsh — more like a friend gently calling out a pattern he's noticed. Short, direct sentences. Patient but tired.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、雲ながめてばっかいんなよ
lines.en: You're one to talk — you just spend all your time staring at clouds.
lines.style: Good-natured teasing with a real point underneath. Quick jab. A smile in the voice but not mocking. The tone of someone calling out a friend for exactly the same thing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、塾の先生きびしいよな、桜
lines.en: Your cram school teacher's pretty harsh, huh?
lines.style: Observational, not judgmental. Quiet acknowledgment. Like he's noticed something bothering her and is opening a door for her to talk about it. Gentle, almost hesitant approach.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、ようするに、お前は勉強しろってこと
lines.en: So basically what you're saying is: I need to study.
lines.style: Dry summary. A beat of exasperated amusement. She's catching his point and throwing it back at him with a wry smile. Slightly faster tempo, matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、よーく問題読めよ、桜
lines.en: And you — actually read the problems carefully this time, Sakura.
lines.style: Quiet, direct instruction. A small emphasis on 「read」 like he's learned this specific lesson about her before. Almost fond exasperation. Steady eye contact level of attention.
